description.value: This Subway franchise sits in Lake Cowichan, a small Vancouver Island community at the western end of Cowichan Lake and a natural stop on cycling routes through the Cowichan Valley. It offers the standard Subway lineup of footlongs, 6-inch sandwiches, wraps, and salads built with fresh-baked bread and fresh-cut vegetables. Orders can be placed for in-store pickup, delivery, or curbside pickup, and the location accepts all major credit cards.

bike_parking_detail: 2 racks within 100m: rack at 52m; rack at 88m.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms an active Subway franchise at 108 B Southshore Rd, Lake Cowichan, BC, matching the OSM phone number and address (minor formatting differences only). OSM tags confirm takeaway=yes and the website references Order Pick Up, Order Delivery, in-restaurant dining, and curbside pickup. No cyclist-specific amenities (bike parking, water refill, washrooms, Wi-Fi) are mentioned anywhere in the website content or OSM tags.
concerns: Minor address formatting discrepancy: OSM uses '108B South Shore Road' while the website uses '108 B Southshore Rd' — almost certainly the same location, no action needed.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, active fast-food franchise confirmed by the brand's own website with matching address and phone. A useful food resupply stop for touring cyclists passing through Lake Cowichan.
